workflows.name: CVE Monitoring with CIRCL
workflows.description: Automatically retrieves vulnerability information from the CIRCL CVE database for specified vendors and products. It creates detailed TheHive alerts containing affected software versions, technical descriptions, vulnerability details, references, and recommended remediation actions.

workflows.name: Block hash as Falcon IOC
workflows.description: Pushes a hash observable flagged as IOC in TheHive to CrowdStrike Falcon as a blocking indicator.

workflows.name: Contain host on critical case
workflows.description: Network-contains the affected Falcon host when a critical case is opened in TheHive and logs the action in the case timeline.

workflows.name: Suspicious Email Campaign Detection
workflows.description: Automatically processes suspicious email alerts, extracts key email details, and identifies related incidents. It groups matching alerts into existing cases or creates new ones in TheHive, helping security teams track and investigate potential email campaigns.

workflows.name: TheHive to Jira ITSM Sync
workflows.description: Automatically creates Jira issues from new TheHive alerts and synchronizes comments between both platforms. It prevents duplicate updates, keeps incident discussions aligned, and closes Jira issues when the corresponding alerts are resolved.

workflows.name: Alert Triage with Recorded Future
workflows.description: Automatically processes Elasticsearch security alerts in TheHive and enriches IP addresses and file hashes with threat intelligence from Recorded Future. It identifies high-risk indicators, escalates critical alerts into cases, and documents malicious findings to streamline incident investigation.

workflows.name: Slack Alert Manager
workflows.description: The Slack Alert Manager workflow automates alert monitoring and response tracking through Slack. It processes reactions, comments, and thread replies to update alert statuses, ensuring timely follow-ups and efficient incident management.
